quest.grege.ae1: You can combine terminals in any crafting table.
quest.grege.ae2: I recommend combining crafting terminal, pattern encoding terminal and extended pattern access terminal.
quest.grege.ae3: If you want challenge, use channels. I won't blame you if you won't!
quest.grege.ae4: This mod features direct link between ProjectE and AE2. Place this item anywhere on your network, and you will be able to see your EMC in AE2. Also this is way better on your world stability over using storage bus on transmutation interface.
quest.grege.ae5: Put this in pattern provider next to a GT machine. Then you can start using circuits (meaning circuit 1, cirucit 2) in recipes, meaning that machine is not locked into doing only 1 circuit recipes.
quest.grege.ae6: This block is used to automatically request crafts from your AE2 system.
quest.grege.ae7: This block is more useful than you think - it can instantly put items in your network, output them and also if you put storage bus on this block, you have a recursive storage system! Very useful for Assembly Line automation.
quest.grege.ae8: You can get these blocks 2 ways:
quest.grege.ae9: 1) ULV machine, that is very cheap, recommended for the start
quest.grege.ae10: 2) Assemblers, these are more expensive to get, but it scales better.
quest.grege.ae11: This terminal contains all of the other terminals in 1 single page. It might seem overwhelming at first, but this will help you with AE2 stuff.
quest.grege.adastra1: Put Ad Astra's oil in this machine, you will get fuel for rockets, even if EMI doesn't show it.
quest.grege.adastra2: Get this armor to survive on the planet.
quest.grege.adastra3: Place oxygen in the oxygen loader, then put in the spacesuit or oxygen tank you want to fill and it fills up automatically!
quest.grege.adastra6: Mercury is optional for now, in LuV you need to visit though.
quest.grege.adastra7: This Ad Astra addon unlocks in LuV.
quest.grege.adastra8: Use Tier 4 rocket to get here.
quest.grege.adastra9: The Ad Astra's raw ores are actually duplicable via Botania, even though its pretty expensive.
quest.grege.adastra10: This addon adds few useful items:
quest.grege.adastra11: 1) Enchantments for your armor to survive in space.
quest.grege.adastra13:
There is:

1) Space Breathing
2) Space Fire Proof
3) Acid Rain Proof
4) Gravity Normalizing

Each gets unlocked at a different planet.
Or enchanting maybe?...
quest.grege.avaritia1: If you want to complete this pack in a normal amount of time, get this multiblock. If you dont want to, get ready to spam assembly lines.
quest.grege.avaritia2: Automating Extreme table is very easy with this. Place it next to a ME packaging provider, and put the pattern into that.
quest.grege.avaritia3: Be prepared - this requires that you do everything.
quest.grege.avaritia4:
Well done!

This armor marks the end of the modpack and there definetly isn't another act!
quest.grege.avaritia8: Right click with the Wand to awaken a allowed block, then capture it and spawn it again and again to get the block drop!
quest.grege.bloodmagic1: Get the altar, its your 'crafting' bench for this mod. Look in the book for the correct multiblock placement.
quest.grege.bloodmagic2:
I recommend getting 2 altars. One is for generating blood (max it out on runes of sacrifice, then combination of transfer, capacity and acceleration runes), the other for crafting - acceleration, capacity runes will be your friend.

You can check the maximum amounts of runes in the Blood Magic book.
quest.grege.bloodmagic3:
You can start off Blood Magic with this.

This is the best way to generate blood. Give it fully maxed out model (you can see which ones are really good if you right click Virtual Sacrificer, more energy = more blood).

Also check out the catalyst, those give you multipliers on the blood recieved (-1 uses means its infinite). You can have multiple Sacrificers per altar.

To bind a Sacrificer to a altar, make a wrench from the same mod, and shift+right click the altar, then right click the Sacrificer.
quest.grege.bloodmagic4:
This is the original way to get started on your Blood Altar.

Right click this to get blood in your altar. It drains HP, but there are multiple ways to regenerate that fast.
quest.grege.bloodmagic5: Place 8 Blank Runes in a ring below the altar.
quest.grege.bloodmagic6:
Add another ring, then add Stone Bricks with Glowstone on top.

Remember, you can change the Blank Runes to any other rune that gives a bonus to the altar.
The abilities of the runes are described in their tooltips, you can also check the book for better description.
quest.grege.bloodmagic7: Add another ring of runes, with Stone Bricks and Large Bloodstone Tiles on top.
quest.grege.bloodmagic8:
The last tier of the altar.

The gap between the last rings are 2 blocks! Also the edge blocks are from Demonite.
quest.grege.bloodmagic9: With this item, you can check the tier and stored blood in your altar.
quest.grege.bloodmagic10:
How to get this fruit?

1) Get a Ritual Diviner
2) Shift+Right Click it until it say Edge of the Hidden Realm
3) Make a Master Ritual Stone and some Ritual Stones
4) Right click the Master with Ritual Diviner to assemble the ritual.
5) Right click the Master with Ritual Activator (You need to have enough LP in your blood network - place Orb in a Altar to charge it)
6) Get inside the dungeon, unlock the doors with keys, and get a Tau Fruit
7) Place the Tau Fruit, then make a animal stand upon it, it will die and feed the fruit. You might need to repeat it a few times, the fruit damages the animal when it grows.
8) You can harvest the Saturated Tau Fruit now!
quest.grege.bloodmagic11:
How to get this?

Its similar to Tau Fruit, you need to find it in a dungeon.

1) Upgrade your Ritual Diviner to Ritual Diviner [Dusk]
2) Change it to Pathway to the Endless Realm ritual
3) Assemble the ritual and start it
4) Find special key (Foreman's or Miner's) in chests, then find the special room
5) Mine the ore! (you can double it)
quest.grege.bloodmagic12: Place 8 Blank Runes in a ring below the altar.
